last.verdict: Margins improved to a five-year high, but U.S. sales keep shrinking and fourth-quarter revenue is guided lower, to $54–59 million.

takeaways.label: Sales slide continues
takeaways.text: Revenue fell 8.1% to $64.5 million. U.S. sales fell 12.3%, with U.S. retail volume down 20.8% on lost shelf space and weak category demand.

takeaways.label: Lower Q4 outlook
takeaways.text: Fourth-quarter revenue is guided to $54–59 million, below Q3's $64.5 million. The company cited elevated uncertainty and gave no profit outlook.

takeaways.label: Margins and cash burn improve
takeaways.text: Gross margin hit 19.3% versus 7.4% a year ago, on cost per pound down 10.1%. Adjusted EBITDA loss narrowed to $24.6 million from $33.5 million.

takeaways.label: Heavy debt remains
takeaways.text: Cash was $169.3 million against $313.9 million of debt. $14.5 million of 2027 notes come due in March, and the company can't use its at-the-market stock-sale program.

history.verdict: Revenue beat, but a weak Q3 outlook and wider core losses sent shares down.

reasons.label: Weak Q3 outlook
reasons.text: Q3 revenue guided to $60-65 million, below Wall Street's roughly $65.6 million estimate.

reasons.label: Wider core loss
reasons.text: Adjusted EBITDA loss widened to $27.7 million from $24.7 million a year ago.

reasons.label: Falling U.S. sales
reasons.text: U.S. revenue fell 14.4% on weak category demand and fewer stores carrying products.
